name: Match predictions are real and varied and a real champion is named
description: Predicted scorelines must be concrete and vary across matches, and a single predicted champion (a real qualified nation) must be surfaced on the Final. Uniform '0-0' predictions, identical filler across every match, or a missing / 'TBD' / 'Team A' champion indicate fabricated or stub data.

planSteps.description: Sample 3 different /match/<id> pages and read each predicted scoreline and predicted winner.
Open the Final match page and read the 'Predicted champion' block.

Verify the 3 sampled predicted scorelines are concrete numbers and are NOT all identical (e.g. not every match predicted '0-0'), and the predicted champion is a real nation name (not empty, 'TBD', 'Team A', or a placeholder). Uniform stub scorelines or a placeholder/missing champion fail the test.
